regions.purpose: Carries dismiss on the left and the primary forward action (Add to a Collection) on the right. In add-to-collection mode it additionally carries Cancel adding.

Shows the draft Location as it would be committed: displayName (or (untitled location) when nothing is resolved or named yet), an address line when the adopted candidate provides one, and the raw coordinates as tertiary detail.

The selection list that resolves the draft. The first row is Use coordinates (the bare-coords outcome, with an inline name field when selected); the remaining rows are the nearby real places offered by the provider.

shows: category or address from cachedMetadata, when the provider supplied it

lists.emptyState: When the provider returns no nearby places — or has not run yet — only the Use coordinates row appears; the draft remains committable through it.
